targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: [2026-08-30 governance, V3-EXQ-966, failure_autopsy_966-436g-951-959-822d-cluster_2026-08-30] The C2 manipulation was INERT: block_contacts are bit-identical between ARM_FIXED_VALUE and ARM_SHUFFLED_VALUE on 4/4 seeds across 4/4 blocks, including blocks 3-4 where the arms' amplitude assignment differs, so frac_high_SHUFFLED = 1 - frac_high_FIXED by construction and fixed_post+shuffled_post sums to exactly 1.000 on every seed. The recorded delta is a RELABELLING of which resource type counts as 'high', not a behavioural contrast. Mechanism: resource_type_benefit_amplitudes scales contact_benefit, which reaches the agent by three routes, all closed at this config. (1) RESIDUE, open but SIGN-GATED: _consume_resource_at sets harm_signal = contact_benefit (causal_grid_world.py:2174) and StepHarness passes it into agent.update_residue every tick (_harness.py:361), but every consumer of the value inside update_residue is gated on the sign -- harm_occurred=(harm_signal<0) at agent.py:10354, and the magnitude-reading branches at L10463/10477/10500, with harm_magnitude=abs(harm_signal) at L10501 reachable only inside 'if harm_signal < 0'. A contact benefit is POSITIVE, so 0.30 and 0.045 are both simply 'not harm' and are discarded identically: the residue field records harm magnitude and has NO consumer for benefit magnitude. (2) agent_health, min(1.0,...) ceiling clamp, decremented only by hazard/contaminated contact -- and the driver sets NUM_HAZARDS=0, so health is pinned at 1.0. (3) agent_energy, floor-clamped at 0.0 under a 0.01/step decay that dominates ~0.8 contacts/episode. use_proxy_fields defaults to False, so body[11] benefit_exposure -- the one unclamped benefit-magnitude channel -- does not exist, and the on_post_step hook is not set by this driver. NUM_HAZARDS=0 closes routes (1) and (2) at once. Two corroborating symptoms: incentive_bank_base_values is {} in all 8 cells (the nominated re-tracking pathway recorded nothing), and P0's ResourceEncoder warmup trained against a constant 0.0 target because resource_field_view is also a proxy-field channel. Separately, C2's verdict logic could not have discriminated even on live arms: margin = max(2*pstdev(delta), 0.10) = 0.640 on a DV bounded in [0,1] (an equivalence bound set by the noise it exists to exclude), and 2 of its 3 branches map to 'supports'. The recorded MECH-144 supports is WITHDRAWN. The recorded MECH-143 weakens is also withdrawn: c1_pass conjoins the substantive repeat-identity check (passed 4/4) with flip_differs, which the driver's own docstring declares a POSITIVE CONTROL, so seed 61's flip failure is an instrument-not-established finding, not claim evidence. non_contributory on both claims. Retest owed on an env config where the amplitude reaches an unclamped channel; a substrate guard against this class is recommended (severity corrupting). PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING this cycle.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.note: WITHDRAWN. An earlier revision proposed creating sd_sd049_amplitude_observability_guard (severity corrupting) with a lint on 'amplitude non-uniform while every channel it can reach is clamped'. That predicate is FALSE: agent_energy resets to 1.0 each episode and decays 0.01/step, so it spends most of a 120-step episode strictly between the clamps and a contact's +contact_benefit*0.5 bump lands unclamped and amp-scaled (+0.15 HIGH vs +0.0225 LOW) into body[3], an observed channel; the min(1.0,...) clamp only absorbs contacts in roughly the first 15 steps after a reset. learning_extracted: WITHDRAWN: an earlier revision asserted the absolute 'the amplitude has no observable consequence at this env config', resting on agent_health being ceiling-clamped (NUM_HAZARDS=0) and agent_energy floor-clamped. The agent_energy half is FALSE -- the floor clamp saturates the DECAY, not the benefit, and energy sits strictly between the clamps for most of each episode. The mechanism for the zero contrast is therefore UNRESOLVED.

ALSO WITHDRAWN as a phrase: 'the two arms are the same run'. Identical block_contacts are identical COUNTS, not proven identical trajectories. 32 exact integer matches remain overwhelming evidence of no measurable behavioural difference, and that is what the direction withdrawals rest on.

What survives and is newly established: the residue route is open but SIGN-GATED -- harm_signal = contact_benefit reaches agent.update_residue every tick (_harness.py:361) and every consumer there is gated on harm_signal < 0 (agent.py:10354, and the magnitude branches at 10463/10477/10500-10501), so a POSITIVE benefit's magnitude is discarded. The residue field has a consumer for harm magnitude and none for benefit magnitude.
An equivalence test whose bound is max(k*pstdev(delta), floor) inflates its own bound with the noise it is meant to exclude; here margin=0.640 on a DV bounded in [0,1].
A verdict ladder in which 2 of 3 branches map to the same direction is not a discrimination.
Perfect complementarity of two arms' proportions (summing to exactly 1.0 on every seed) is the fingerprint of a relabelling; check it before reading any delta.

learning_extracted: WITHDRAWN IN FULL: an earlier revision of this target claimed a RECORDING GAP and routed a 959a re-run whose 'only change' was to record the per-stratum statistics. The manifest carries arm_results[*].state_stratification on every ARM_ANNEAL/ARM_NO_ANNEAL row -- median_rsr, strata counts, both divergence rates and the diverged/non-diverged raw_score_range means -- in all 12 relevant cells, and both criteria reproduce exactly (C_STATE seeds 46+48, C_ANNEAL seed 43). The error: inspecting arm_results[0].keys(), which is the A0_OFF yoked reference that legitimately has no stratification, and generalising one row to the schema. Reusable lesson: on a heterogeneous arm schema, check the UNION of keys across arm ids, never the first row.

The strata ARE a per-seed median split and it IS skewed -- median_rsr sits 1-2 orders below the mean in 4/6 seeds (42: 3.013 vs ~15; 46: 2.436 vs ~20-24; 47: 5.937 vs 54-82; 48: 9.669 vs 40-62) -- so the 'decisive' half runs from just-above-median into the extreme tail and is not a confident REGIME. This limits leg (iii)'s sharpness; it does not touch the whole-arm null.
Divergence rate depends only weakly on the stratum: |decisive - near_tie| is under 0.03 in 7 of 12 cells and never exceeds 0.1031 (seed 47 NO_ANNEAL), against base rates of 0.68-0.91.

There is no manipulation-ENGAGEMENT gate on the ON arm (sigma_scale_mean 0.662-0.961). Its effect here is to make the SINGLE C_ANNEAL pass less credible, not to rescue the leg: seed 43 is both the sole pass and the seed where the anneal engaged just 3.9%.

Leg (ii)'s miss is a WEAK INCONSISTENT TREND, not a reversal: the diverged/non-diverged mean-RSR ratio is 0.955 / 1.001 / 1.102 / 0.842 / 0.946 / 0.728 -- the predicted direction in 4 of 6 seeds, reversed in 2, clearing the 10% margin in 2. An earlier revision asserted '4 of 6 in the wrong direction', which inverts the count.
